adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` defines computed keys as `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. `z.string()` returns a Zod object, so `.toString()` evaluates immediately to a literal string like "[object Object]", not a catchall/dynamic key. As a result, fields such as `expiry_date` / `expires_in` are treated as unknown and (with `z.object(...)` default behavior) stripped from `data` during `safeParse`. When this minimum schema is used (credential sharing enabled + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` set), refreshed token responses can lose expiry information, leading to stale/missing expiry being persisted/used.
